key_insight: MOFFieldBench establishes electron-density and electrostatic-potential fields as complementary learning representations to atomic structures for metal-organic frameworks.
engineering_relevance: Electronic-field learning can support MOF screening for adsorption and separation while providing initial densities that accelerate first-principles calculations.
method: Align crystallographic structures with electron-density and electrostatic-potential fields for approximately 46,000 MOFs.
Combine field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representations.
Benchmark field reconstruction, 13-property prediction, multimodal fusion and pairwise cross-modal retrieval.
evidence_signal: Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks over the best unimodal reference, and predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59% on average in paired tests.
watch_item: Generating reference electronic fields remains computationally costly, and the reported gains should not be assumed to generalize beyond the evaluated tasks and paired tests.
paper_title: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
